items.title: Genshin Impact Maker’s Nodusfall Sure Looks Like Multiplayer Elden Ring
items.summary: Gamescom 2026 kicked off with a major surprise in the form of Nodusfall, a multiplayer souls-like from develop

content.v: Gamescom 2026 kicked off with a major surprise in the form of Nodusfall, a multiplayer souls-like from developer Hoyoverse, the studio behind free-to-play gacha games like Genshin Impact and Zenless Zone Zero .

As shown in the trailer and later described by Gamescom Opening Night Live host Geoff Keighley, players take on the roles of Weavers, heroes who must band together to battle "mythic beings" in a world where "divine authority has crumbled and order has collapsed," Keighley said.

The trailer wasn't shy about its inspirations, namely 2022's Elden Ring . Multiple shots in the trailer look like they could have been ripped straight out of From Software's GOTY open-world RPG, including a boss enemy that looks nearly identical to Elden Ring's infamous Malenia. Another boss in the trailer looks extremely reminiscent of Elden Ring's Godfrey, complete with a lion-esque creature.

From Software, of course, released its own multiplayer version of Elden Ring, Elden Ring Nightreign, in 2025. Another multiplayer From Software experiment, The Duskbloods, releases later this year as a Switch 2 exclusive.
https://www.gamespot.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/08/gamescom-Opening-Night-Live-2026-60-19-screenshot.png?w=636

Given Hoyoverse's track record, the real question is how Nodusfall will be monetized and if it will feature similar gacha systems to that of the studio's wildly popular open-world action-RPG Genshin Impact.
No release date or platforms for Nodus Fall were given, but all of Hoyoverse's previous games have released on PC, with some later coming to consoles as well.

items.title: Rainbow 6 Tactics Looks Like If Siege And XCOM: Chimera Squad Had A Baby
items.summary: During Gamescom Opening Night Live , Ubisoft announced the next game in the long-running Tom Clancy series: Ra

content.v: During Gamescom Opening Night Live , Ubisoft announced the next game in the long-running Tom Clancy series: Rainbow 6 Tactics. The announcement trailer showcased how the turn-based tactics game will play--it looks pretty much like Rainbow Six Siege and XCOM: Chimera Squad had a baby.

And it's entirely single-player, which is great! I love playing Siege, but after years away, I simply cannot enjoy it anymore. The game has too many operators to keep track of (any hero shooter with 50+ characters is too much) and the skill ceiling to enjoy the game is so high--I've simply fallen behind and every month away makes it harder to try and jump back in. Rainbow 6 Tactics looks appealing because it lets me get back into Siege (kinda) without having to worry about other online players.

And the game looks very cool, likely because it's being helmed by Ubisoft Paris, a studio that helped create Mario + Rabbids Sparks of Hope , which was super excellent for taking the formula for turn-based tactics games and evolving it. In Sparks of Hope's case, it was rewarding the strategy of purposeful movement. Rainbow 6 Tactics seems to also be building on the turn-based-tactics game formula, but instead focusing hard on how a battle starts.

Like Siege, Rainbow 6 Tactics' missions are split into phases. In the initial phase, you use drones to uncover enemy positions, hostage locations, defensive armaments, and more. When that's done, you use whatever information you have to strategize during the breach planning phase, positioning your chosen operators at specific entry points and dictating how they'll get inside--burst through a window, knock down a wall, shoot a target from distance, etc. When you execute, all of your operators then act simultaneously .
https://www.gamespot.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/08/assets_2026_08_1787584018_TCRST_Screenshot_ActionScreen_PC_AnnoucementGamesCom_250826_815PM_CEST.png?w=636

From there, the rest of the mission proceeds as most turn-based-tactics games do, with each side taking their turn in combat, trying to land shots depending on a percentage chance to hit, and using cover and special abilities to turn the tide of battle. And you direct one operator at a time, like other games. The one big difference to it seems to take inspiration from Siege: breakable environments.

And, of course, that first part of every mission looks very different from most other turn-based tactics games. That system of set-up and breach phases really intrigues me. The game seems to be putting a huge onus on trying to set yourself up for success as much as possible on turn one with a perfectly executed and synchronized assault, potentially putting yourself into a tricky scenario if you don't do your due diligence. So many tactics games see you reacting to an enemy already aware of you, so I'm interested to see how a game in the genre works where you essentially have a turn before a mission even begins.
https://www.gamespot.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/08/assets_2026_08_1787583967_TCRST_Screenshot_SquadSelection_Sony_AnnoucementGamesCom_250826_815PM_CEST.png?w=636

In the game, you play as Paul Bishop, aka Six (a familiar face for those who played Rainbow Six: Vegas 2). You have 15 of Siege's operators under your command and you're trying to rebuild Team Rainbow while still responding to terrorist threats. In a pre-brief for the trailer announcement, we saw Ash, Zofia, Nøkk, Glaz, Doc, Montagne, Sledge, Finka, and Twitch--community developer Emilie Cerkiewicz says that the chosen operators are among the most "iconic" of Siege and that players will see fan-favorites, so I assume the likes of Smoke, Hibana, and Dokkaebi will be there too.

Rainbow 6 Tactics' story will have dozens of handcrafted maps and take place between the events of Siege Year 10 and Year 11 (the current season). This probably means that Year 11 operators Solid Snake and Noor aren't in the game.

Rainbow 6 Tactics is set to launch in 2027 for PC, PlayStation 5, and Xbox Series X|S. The game will have no in-game store (like, at all) or in-game monetization systems, and won't be a live-service title--all of which feels impossible for a new Ubisoft game, but that's what Cerkiewicz said during the pre-brief, so who am I to doubt?

items.title: Humankind 2 Forces You To Deal With The Consequences Of Climate Change
items.summary: Gamescom Opening Night Live has been dropping trailers for all manner of games, and if you're a fan of histori

content.v: Gamescom Opening Night Live has been dropping trailers for all manner of games, and if you're a fan of historical turn-based strategy games, then you can check out the first look at Humankind 2 . Just like the first game, Humankind 2 tasks you with starting a civilization and guiding it through various eras by using diplomacy, military might, and new technologies to stay a step ahead of your rivals. Developer Amplitude Studios says that players can expect the core 4X experience to offer new ways to rewrite history.

According to the developer, Humankind 2 has incorporated feedback from 2021's Humankind to introduce new progression systems, features, enhanced visuals, a modernized user interface, and several other gameplay improvements. Cultural evolution is designed to be deeper, and in each new Era players reach, they can adopt a culture that expands and deepens their civilization's identity. This will, in turn, unlock exclusive customs through expanded cultural progression trees, creating distinct nations throughout the ages.

Of course, players can also stick to the history books when guiding their chosen culture, but new stories from around the world will make it very tempting to experience new scenarios. Amplitude Studios added that the climate will also play a major role, as changing weather systems will transform the strategic map over time. Not only will you need to adapt to climate change, but you'll also need to weigh short-term growth against consequences that may endure for generations.
Humankind 2 will launch for PC in 2027, and if you want to check out the first game, it's on sale for 90% off on Steam until September 8.

items.title: Murals Turns Famous Fairy Tales Into A Silly Action-Adventure
items.summary: Today, during Gamescom Opening Night Live , Disney Illusion Island developer Dlala Studios introduced its next

content.v: Today, during Gamescom Opening Night Live , Disney Illusion Island developer Dlala Studios introduced its next game: Murals, which puts a new spin on some classic childhood stories, and will launch on PC in 2027.

Murals is an isometric action-adventure game set within multiple famous fairy tales, including Hansel and Gretel, The Little Mermaid, and Rapunzel, but not the way you might remember them. Rapunzel's hair, for example, is actively trying to kill her, while "Sleeping Beauty" is suffering from insomnia and hasn't slept in weeks.
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=D42nkf8EHMk

Players will control a nameless hero as they fight through these twisted fairy tales with help from Eeries, which the game describes as "mystical, slightly very haunted, doo-dads and whatchamacallits" that enhance the hero's abilities.

Some Eeries enhance the hero's weapon, like Strength In Misery's ability to deal more damage to enemies with status effects, while others affect the hero themselves, like Thorny's passive ability to sometimes damage any attacking enemy that hurts the hero.

items.title: I attempted to become a professional driver in a GTA 5 where every car had no friction
items.summary: Gotta make ends meet somehow.

content.v: If you remember, uh, yesterday, then you'll remember how I have recently modded GTA 5 to essentially deactivate friction on all NPC cars. Also, all NPC cars are perpetually, unstoppably in motion. Long story short: they keep accidentally flying and/or exploding.
So I thought what I could do today would be to try to become a professional driver in that world.

I have installed The Getaway (Driver Missions) , a mod which lets you dial a new number in your phone in order to undertake road quests . In practice, that means driving to a place, picking a guy up, then driving that guy to another place. At some point in this process you lose the cops.

All well and good, but not overly dramatic. What makes it a lot more hair-raising is every other driver on Los Santos' roads no longer obeys the laws of physics. Even driverless cars are irrepressibly compelled forwards, making it damn-near impossible to actually acquire a car to undertake these missions.

Fortunately, I am a lateral thinker. I simply used my car gun to summon a car directly into a wall. As the unstoppable force met the immoveable object, I was able to get in and go about my business. Sort of. When every car in the game is incapable of stopping but perfectly capable of murder, every single intersection in Los Santos becomes a dance with death.

Even picking up my fare was dicey—as he attempted to get into my car (which was, for whatever reason, an inexplicably snow-covered North Yankton police truck), a taxi cab floated nearby like a leaf on the wind, pancaking a separate pedestrian mere inches from my passenger.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/gJGyyHdzZG8q7a8jDuvLGE.gif
I guess what I'm saying is: walkable urban spaces now.

items.title: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 Beta Pushes Unplanned Update to Address Fan Feedback
items.summary: Infinity Ward has pushed an unplanned update for the Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 beta in order to quickly a

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/08/14/call-of-duty-modern-warfare-4-beta-campaign-mission-1786722459406.png
Infinity Ward has pushed an unplanned update for the Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 beta in order to quickly address fan feedback.

Although the first beta weekend for Modern Warfare 4 is coming to a close, Infinity Ward has pushed an unplanned update that will fix spawns. This isn't the final update for spawns as part of this beta, but is an "early piece" of a larger improvement, so fans aren't being tortured during the final moments of this beta. The fix is live in all modes besides Hardpoint, but a fix will arrive for Hardpoint as well during the beta's second weekend.

We were supposed to be done with updates today… Supposed to be. We pushed out an early piece of the larger spawn improvements we’re working on. It’s live now across all modes except Hardpoint. Hardpoint changes will come in Weekend 2. Go run some matches. 🫡

This is likely just one of many fixes coming ahead of weekend two. Players have been vocal about spawn issues, the time to kill being too rapid, and more. Infinity Ward is already being more responsive and receptive to beta feedback than its previous Call of Duty game, Modern Warfare 2 (2022). That game caught a lot of flack for ignoring fans when it came to things that really rubbed them the wrong way. Although it was a massive commercial success, it remains one of the more divisive Call of Duty games in recent memory due to fans disagreeing over the direction in which it tried to steer the franchise.
In a recent interview with IGN , Infinity Ward's Joe Cecot acknowledged the studio's missteps with its previous at bat and promised fans would see differences in how MW4 was handled.

"I think in MW2, we definitely didn't communicate as well as we should have," said Cecot. "I think we've remedied that in crazy ways with this project. Even with the amount of stuff that I get sent to my desk to review like, 'Hey, we want to respond to this.' And then I review copy or I'm writing something, it's a huge shift. That's going to continue into live support and I think you see it at our studio head level. [Infinity Ward co-studio head] Mark Grigsby is posting, the Infinity Word account is posting, the Call of Duty account is posting, and they're all in unison posting. They're not separate from each other. I think it's really powerful and it feels really good to us."
Modern Warfare 4's second beta weekend will begin on Friday, August 28 at 10AM PT. The full game will release on October 23, with early access for the campaign opening on October 16.
Cade Onder is a freelancer for IGN's news team. He covers all things entertainment, including gaming, film, and more. You can find him on Twitter @Cade_Onder.

others.title: 《影之刃零》Steam预估销量爆炸！达黑神话同期73%

content.v: 近日，根据行业数据分析机构Alinea Analytics的最新预估数据显示，国产武侠动作游戏《 影之刃零 》(Phantom Blade Zero)有望实现爆款首发。
Steam商店地址： 点击进入
根据Alinea的估算，开启预购一周内，《影之刃零》在Steam平台的预购销量，已经带来约1450万美元营收，Alinea同时将本作和其他国产大作进行了对比，《影之刃零》的这份数据，已经达到《黑神话：悟空》同期惊人数据的73%，是《明末：渊虚之羽》同期预购数据的6.4倍。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20260826/1787675780_139222_jpg_r.jpg
除此之外，机构数据表明，《影之刃零》愿望单人数已突破200万，在Steam愿望单排行榜大幅领先，是今年待发售游戏当中愿望单数量最高的作品。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20260826/1787675780_188919_jpg_r.jpg
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20260826/1787675780_600822_jpg_r.jpg
Steam愿望单排名，《影之刃零》为2026年发售游戏中愿望单数量最高
Alinea特别强调，《影之刃零》和《黑神话：悟空》有着非常相似的气质：高预算制作、画面表现惊艳，根植本土文化的国产动作游戏，同时收获东西方玩家共鸣。然而这并不能代表《影之刃零》肯定会复刻《黑神话：悟空》那样的现象级热度，但不可否认，能够和《黑神话：悟空》处在同一量级区间，本作的起点已经格外强劲。
分析师Daniel Camilo表示，《黑神话：悟空》是属于一代人一遇的文化现象，几乎所有中国国内的受众都能接触到相关话题，海外的玩家也都有所耳闻，而《影之刃零》的受众则更多集中在核心玩家群体，不过体量同样巨大。当然后续热度也存在持续发酵、雪球式增长的可能性。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20260826/1787675780_312066.jpg
《影之刃零》还获得了PlayStation的高度宣发支持：索尼为《影之刃零》专门举办了20分钟State of Play 专场发布会，以及PlayStation官方的多篇专题报道。在PS5平台上，游戏还将支持触觉反馈、自适应扳机、3D音频等功能。Alinea指出，这种宣发待遇对于第三方外部游戏来说是十分罕见的，换言之，《影之刃零》拿到了堪比索尼第一方游戏级别的宣传资源。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20260826/1787675780_856730_jpg_r.jpg

与此同时，《影之刃零》现已经拿到国内版号，可以正式在中国大陆上线，充分挖掘本土市场潜力。加上功夫传奇巨星甄子丹以创意监制、核心动捕演员的身份全程深度参与，从功夫理念、动作体系、镜头叙事、临场武打编排等全方位共同创作，让游戏战斗体系取材于原汁原味的中国武术，为《影之刃零》搭建起一套独属于中式功夫内核的动作设计体系。游戏还融入大量精彩的中国文化遗产元素，包括舞狮、峨眉剑法、京剧、水墨美术等诸多特色内容。不难看出，本作同样能唤起和《黑神话：悟空》相似的民族自豪感。
《影之刃零》将于10月29日登陆PS5、PS5 Pro以及 PC(Steam、Epic、WeGame、TapTap PC)平台，有望成为2026年商业表现最亮眼的作品之一，值得玩家们期待。

items.title: McDonald’s Halo: Campaign Evolved Skin Has Me Loathin’ It
items.summary: Eating a Big Mac can help you obtain a special armor set for Master Chief in the UK and Ireland. Thanks to a n

content.v: Eating a Big Mac can help you obtain a special armor set for Master Chief in the UK and Ireland. Thanks to a new McDonald's collaboration with Xbox, there is a new Halo: Campaign Evolved skin that's mainly red and gray, with a yellow visor and flourishes. It costs 1,500 rewards points in the McDonald's app--a tier in the US that will get you a free apple pie, small coffee, or vanilla cone.

Now we could talk about the hilarity of a Master Chief skin for a game predominately played from the first-person perspective, though Halo: Campaign Evolved does let you experience the classic game in third-person . Or we could talk about how this particular armor set (seen below via RebsGaming ) looks like something that should be available to just customize within the title's menu. It's really not much more than a palette swap.

But probably the biggest issue is the armor set, named Side Mission, just screams bland and boring. Like if you're going to have a McDonald's-specific skin in Halo: Campaign Evolved, give it some fun character. Put the iconic "M" arch on Chief's helmet, for instance, sort of like the added decal flair on Magneto's helmet . Or make the visor look like Ronald McDonald, similar to what we did with the horrifying thumbnail on this story.

Now Halo: Campaign Evolved isn't the only Xbox-owned game to get a special reward at McDonald's in the UK and Ireland . The other titles involved in the collaboration are Forza Horizon 6, Fallout 76, Candy Crush Saga, World of Warcraft, and Overwatch. GameSpot has reached out to McDonald's about a similar promotion coming to other parts of the world, including North America.

We also have codes to grab free alternate armor sets in Halo: Campaign Evolved . For more, check out GameSpot's Halo: Campaign Evolved review . The game is available on PC, Xbox Series X|S, and for the first time ever, PS5.

items.title: Lenovo says it is 'clear' Legion Go faults 'not user error' and even devices out of warranty could be repaired 'free of charge'
items.summary: Users have been complaining about this problem for a few weeks now.

others.title: 10.1.0 | Chorus of Sin

content.v: If after installing BIOS version N3CN42WW on your Lenovo Legion Go , you have found it unable to get past the BIOS or entirely bricked , Lenovo says it's not your fault. The good news is that you will likely be able to get it fixed for free.

Taking to the Lenovo forums (via VideoCardz ), Lenovo clarified that it was able to replicate the same bricking problem with three devices, while other Lenovo teams were able to update to N3CN42WW without any problems. They say, "as such the issue is most likely related to [a] specific component used on mainboards in a certain batch or batches, or the issue needs to have specific circumstances to manifest."
As part of this, the employee also states that "while the root cause has not been identified yet, it is clear it is not user error."

Finally, Lenovo confirms that those under warranty should aim to get the device fixed or replaced and "in the case of out-of-warranty devices, it should be repaired free of charge, but please check local laws."

The user the Lenovo employee was replying to is based in the European Union, and Lenovo clarifies that those in the EU will be covered even if not under warranty if the BIOS update caused the problem.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/D8gRCxfXMVJ2rhoYVKfM9L.jpg

One user has replied to this post stating that they were told their Legion Go couldn't be repaired in Belgium as they were out of warranty, so one can only hope that the support team are made aware of this communication from Lenovo.

This clarity has been expected by the Lenovo community for some time, who have been reporting bricking problems with this specific BIOS version for a while now. They were likely hoping for some sort of communication weeks ago when it first popped up, even if it were Lenovo simply acknowledging it has seen the problem. Version N3CN42WW appeared to have been released in June and was removed at the start of August, with no communication from Lenovo at the time. That means users were left in the dark for potentially weeks with a handheld that would simply not boot.

On August 4, a post went up on the Legion Go Subreddit , warning users not to update their BIOS. The comments section for this post has multiple users claiming their devices were also bricked by the update. At the time, one user reported they were given a price of €237 (about $273) from Lenovo to fix it. It has not been made clear if any users who paid the repair fee have gotten their fee back with this new communication from Lenovo.

Though it has not been possible to download the BIOS update via Lenovo for a few weeks now, users on Reddit were still cautious of updates even this week (though admittedly, part of that seems to be users taking the opportunity to jokingly take a swipe at Lenovo).

Now, if you try to update your Lenovo Legion Go BIOS , you will find version N3CN40WW, which was updated on August 5 this year, but it hasn't been made clear what the difference is between this and the same version number which launched on January 6 this year. Still, even if users will be getting their devices fixed, this period of uncertainty has likely taken some of the shine off the device for some. And with the memory crisis in full swing , buying a new device is simply unfeasible for many.

items.title: Total War: Warhammer shows off its spicy new endgames, including a 'rat counter' that tells you how many Skaven still need killing in The Vermintide
items.summary: 165,000 DEAD RATS.

others.title: GTA 6 Leaks: A Timeline Of The Events So Far

content.v: Since the full reveal of Total War: Warhammer's new Lords of the End Times expansion, the content is coming in thick and fast. Last week, Creative Assembly showed off Neferata, the incoming Free-LC lord, alongside the extremely fun-looking rework for the Vampire Counts . This week we're getting more information about the new end game crises.

The latest livestream went deep on Archaon's new Chaos Invasion endgame, Nagash's Great Ritual of Nagash, and the Skaven's Vermintide. We got to a rundown of each crisis, saw differently devastated world regions and special devastated battle maps, and even got an introduction to new End Times units.

Most notable for me, though, was the news that The Vermintide endgame features a rat counter that shows how many Skaven you still have left to kill. "You can see an estimated number of rats" says Mitch Heastie, Lead Game Designer on Total War: Warhammer, during the livestream. "It is based on the actual numbers, like roughly."

The counter on the stream (at 40:37) reads 165,000 RATS, who make up 60 Skaven armies you'll have to defeat. The Vermintide end game does sound fun, though. You'll have to destroy Skaven Under-Cities before they blow up your settlements with Doomspheres and quickly recapture territory, as the rat men will keep spawning armies otherwise. There are also new buildings to help deal with the menace, and it sounds like there's a narrative component, as each defeated army helps you uncover the Skaven's insidious plot.

By comparison, Nagash's end game is more focused on the climactic final battle. As the Black Pyramid slowly travels to Nagashizzar, you'll have to mitigate the Lord of Undeath's conquests and weaken him as much as possible for that final confrontation. And of course, there's Archaon's reworked Chaos Invasion , where you'll have to defeat his armies and fortresses to weaken his ward save before he destroys too much of the world. Otherwise he'll be functionally immortal. Easy enough.

I've got to say, all of these updates alongside the Lords of the End Times content have me very excited to play on September 24. With the news that anyone who buys one of the expansion lords gets access to Immortal Empires , it's also going to be one of the best times to start playing Total War: Warhammer as well.

content.v: Ahead of the first anniversary of Dispatch , developer AdHoc Studio has announced that the superhero workplace comedy-drama is finally getting a physical edition release for PS5, Xbox Series X|S, and Switch. Published in partnership with PM Studios, the release offers fans a choice between a standard and a steelbook edition, each featuring an assortment of physical and digital goodies.

The $50 Standard Deluxe Edition includes the full game on disc/cartridge, all DLC, an artbook with a digital copy, four digital comics, a Superhero Dispatch Network booklet, a download key for the game soundtrack, and a double-sided poster. If you feel like spending a little more, you can grab the Steelbook Deluxe Edition for $60. This includes all of the aforementioned extras, as well as a steelbook cover featuring box art created in-house at AdHoc Studio. The steelbook edition might also be released later due to manufacturing times, AdHoc added.

Each version will be available from retailers such as Amazon, Best Buy, GameStop, Target, Walmart, and more. With the Nintendo copy of Dispatch, AdHoc has noted that it is the Switch 1 version of the game, and it includes the Switch 2 Edition upgrade pack--as well as some censorship, but the studio did manage to apply some hilarious fixes to meet Nintendo's standards.
Dispatch Deluxe Edition contents
https://www.gamespot.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/08/Dispatch-steelbook.jpg?w=636

On top of all that, the complete Dispatch soundtrack is also getting a physical release via Lost in Cult Records. Andrew Arcadi and Skyler Barto's original score will be joined by several licensed tracks, and this will be available in two editions. The Prime Edition has all three records pressed on classic black vinyl, while the Astral Edition offers the same three records, each pressed in the colors of a key Superhero Dispatch Network employee: Mecha Man blue, Invisigal translucent purple, and Blonde Blazer's red-and-yellow color scheme.

The first 500 Astral sets ship with a certificate of authenticity signed by composer Andrew Arcadi through Lost in Cult's website, and if you want to double up, you can get both the Standard Deluxe Edition of Dispatch with a vinyl edition of your choice bundled together. This deal will also save 10% off the pair.

One of last year's hit games -- despite it being snubbed during the awards season--Dispatch is a narrative-heavy adventure that follows Robert Robertson III, formerly the superhero Mecha Man. With his mech suit trashed, Robertson takes up a post at the local branch of the Superhero Dispatch Network (SDN) as a dispatcher, overseeing a team of former supervillains. A critical and commercial hit, a sequel might already be in development .

items.title: GTA 6 leaker goes full cornball in newest videos, insists 'using crypto is the only way'
items.summary: Man, give it a rest.

content.v: Listen, I know the last week of GTA 6 leaks have let us all—except the employees of Rockstar—enjoy a bit of collective mania. But as time goes on, I'm beginning to suspect that the mysterious leaker who's been using their illicit GTA 6 footage as a vehicle for their personal memecoin scheme might have ulterior motives.

As Take-Two's subpoena-seeking effort to track down the leaker intensifies, Cyberleek seems to be responding to the increasingly obvious writing on the wall by leaning even harder into the crypto cornball act. In a fresh pair of GTA 6 gameplay uploads, the world's most wanted allium has descended to a new low of sheer saucelessness as they seek additional funds for their alleged "operational costs."
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/oyCBNdsGECuwLjmBdukJRD.jpg

As with Cyberleek's previous leaks, their two newest GTA 6 videos—one showing protagonist Jason puttering around a nightclub, another capturing an evening bike ride at a Vice City beach—prominently feature a text screed and QR code directing viewers to the website where they've been able to "support" Cyberleek's "effort" (i.e. give them electronic crime money).
The watermark's latest iteration, however, indicates Cyberleek isn't enjoying the scrutiny that comes with using the highest-profile game leak for peddling cryptocurrency.

"Stop the hate. Channel that energy into protests. Not at those actually fighting for you," Cyberleek writes. "CL is taking huge risks in this battle. Leeks are free and donations cover operational costs, using crypto is the only way."
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/3txuvHvEeh3kZeGd2nQWPD.jpg

Cyberleek has repeatedly claimed to be "fighting for gamers" throughout this debacle, but so far hasn't provided any explanation as to how they intend to do so beyond writing a generic manifesto and urging viewers to stand outside Rockstar' offices while holding game discs . Because gamers are mad about the disc thing, see. They're just like us.

Don't worry, though: They've insisted that the funds raised by promoting their $Cyberleek token will go toward a definitely real, not-at-all suspect "secret project." Presumably, that project involves movement-critical objectives like ' being paid a bunch of money' and 'surviving the impending legal fees.'

As for the leaks themselves, the latest videos—which you can track down easily enough if you're inclined—are pretty mundane. In the nightclub clip, Jason doesn't do much other than watch women idly hit vape pens, engage in a perfunctory spasm on the dance floor, and exchange some limp greetings with a dancer.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/rfvNwNqEZJRsH5nU7xDdTD.jpg

The beach clip is the more impressive of the two: The density of NPCs and environmental detail is striking, and both the wave and lighting tech looks—in a word—gorgeous. There is a moment where a cluster of people walk out of the ocean as though doing so was indistinguishable from strolling down a sidewalk, but I'll let that slide.

Evidently, Cyberleek didn't get the immediate reaction they'd like from using those two leaks to tell the masses that they really gotta fork over some more cash for real please it's my birthday. They've since posted a third leak video—making this the most they've uploaded in a 24 hour period since their leaks began—with yet another new watermark treatment.

"People are confused," Cyberleek's on-screen text reads as Jason enters an in-game used game store. "This is not about actual discs. It is about ownership. Resale rights still matter—even in a digital-only era."
Notably, today's third upload doesn't feature the usual inclusion of Cyberleek's mascot character and an instruction to "trade $Cyberleek." We'll see how long that lasts.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/ZF5ZJsyvbhJRVSDmd9H3jA.jpg

items.title: NBA 2K27 Is Teasing a GTA 6-Themed Event in Collaboration with Rockstar Games
items.summary: NBA 2K27 is teasing a crossover with Rockstar Games, seemingly to promote Grand Theft Auto 6.

others.title: The upcoming Resident Evil movie will have first-person POVs as it demonstrates how authenticity is a moving target for a series that spans 30 years

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/08/25/nba-2k-x-gta-6-1787673426738.jpg
NBA 2K27 is teasing a crossover with Rockstar Games, seemingly to promote Grand Theft Auto 6 .

At the end of the trailer for NBA 2K27 Season 1, there's a very cryptic tease. The camera tilts down toward a purple-ish poster sporting palm trees, which looks awfully similar to the very first artwork Rockstar released for GTA 6. Seagulls and police sirens can be heard in the background before the camera pans over to an arcade cabinet. One machine has the 2K logo and the other has the Rockstar Games logo. On the screens, the words "Season 3" can be seen in the GTA 6 font and color scheme.

Seasons tend to last about six weeks, so we can expect Season 3 to launch around the time of GTA 6's release in November. It's unclear what exactly this will offer, especially since NBA 2K is an E-rated game and the GTA series pushes the boundaries with its M-ratings. However, it appears to be part of a larger effort to ramp up marketing for what will undoubtedly be one of the biggest releases in entertainment history.

A lot of fans have been frustrated with the lack of marketing for GTA 6 up until now. There have been two trailers and some screenshots to go along with pre-orders, but that's about it as of right now. However, things will ramp up later this week when Rockstar Games releases an extended look at the game on Netflix . Take-Two Interactive CEO Strauss Zelnick previously teased a big marketing campaign for GTA 6 , and it seems like the decision to partner with Netflix and Take-Two's other juggernaut franchise, NBA 2K, will help emphasize the significance of this release.

Maybe players will be able to rep Vice City-themed gear or maybe there will be a Vice City basketball court in NBA 2K27. Basketball appears to be a part of GTA 6, as recently revealed in leaked gameplay for the title , but it's unclear how big of a role that mini-game will play in GTA 6. Either way, all will be revealed in the coming months.
Cade Onder is a freelancer for IGN's news team. He covers all things entertainment, including gaming, film, and more. You can find him on Twitter @Cade_Onder.

items.title: Marvel Tokon Devs Confess Regaining Trust After Fumbled PC Launch Will Be 'Extremely Challenging'
items.summary: Arc System Works has apologized for Marvel Tokon: Fighting Souls' PC launch and admitted it will be "extremely

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/08/25/marvel-tokon-pc-launch-regaining-trust-1787673125546.png
Arc System Works has apologized for the troubled PC launch of Marvel Tokon: Fighting Souls , and admitted it will now be "extremely difficult" to regain player trust.

Producer Takeshi Yamanaka offered a post-mortem on the release of the studio's new superhero fighting game during an interview with VGC . He noted that, when it comes to the content itself, fans have mostly nice things to say about Marvel Tokon, but the positivity isn't being shared by users across all platforms.

"They’re playing matches every day, they’re in training mode, they’re coming up with new combos, and we see them posting those on social media," Yamanaka said. "However, at the same time, unfortunately, in the PC version of the game, there have been in-game issues experienced by many players, which we really apologise to the player base for all of these problems."

Marvel Tokon brought tag-team gameplay to PC, PlayStation 5, and Xbox Series X/S August 6, 2026. While reviewers largely lobbed high scores its way (IGN gave it a 9/10 ), those on PC instead took to Steam to leave reviews of their own.

Arc System Works' new fighting game plummeted to "Mixed" reviews in all languages less than 24 hours after launch as players reported stuttering issues and forced PlayStation sign-in requirements. The weekend following its release on PC was only plagued by more negativity as the problems persisted, with the only message from the studio at the time being its promise to "investigate" reports of "performance issues." The state of Marvel Tokon on PC reportedly was so bad that even famed fighting game community content creator Maximilian Christiansen (a.k.a. Maximilian Dood) uninstalled the game in front of thousands of livestream viewers .

Arc System Works was able to speedily push out an update the following Monday, fixing many of the performance issues players had reported. But while Steam reviews have slightly rebounded, it's clear there's a long road ahead not only for Marvel Tokon but for the studio itself.

Yamanaka said "the team is hard at work to continue working on resolving remaining issues," noting two of the patches that have arrived since that early August release date. He also admitted that getting the Marvel fighting game in tip-top shape is only part of the battle.

"I do think that it's an extremely challenging task that we need to undertake," he said when asked about regaining trust, "where we sincerely want to put all of our effort forward to create an environment where the players can experience this game that we’ve worked so hard to create, and that we do have a lot of confidence that the game itself will be really fun for them."

Yamanaka again apologized for Marvel Tokon on PC after it "created a lot of trouble for the players." He and the rest of the team are hoping the community will stick around not only for those incoming fixes but more for the game itself, too.

"I would like to just say that I truly appreciate every single player who purchased the game around the launch," he added. "And to some players on the PC who were kind enough to purchase the game, but then they experienced these issues and were unable to play the game in its best way, and maybe left the game for the moment or even refunded. I would just like to express my sincere apologies for all of those issues that they’ve experienced.

"I do feel that it will not be an easy task at all to regain the trust that we've lost from this. However, this is an issue that we're facing head-on, and we’re trying to tackle it directly to try to continue working with all that we have and to provide an environment where players will be able to smoothly experience the game.

The Arc System Works producer continued, saying, "I feel that is the most that we can do." As additional updates are launched, he said, "all we can do is do our best and pray that that sentiment will reach the player base."

Either way, Marvel Tokon: Fighting Souls is just getting started. DLC content is confirmed to be in the works, with Phoenix Cyclops already announced as a playable character set to join the roster this fall. Dataminers uncovered five more potential fighters earlier this month .
